from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

ALLOWED_CAUSES = [
    "破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪",
    "行政主体 - 民政行政管理（民政）",
    "劳动争议，人事争议",
    "知识产权与竞争",
    "非刑事赔偿 - 错误执行赔偿",
    "继承纠纷",
    "贪污受贿罪",
    "行政行为 - 行政监督",
    "行政行为 - 行政登记",
    "执行案由 - 行政",
    "危害公共安全罪",
    "物权保护纠纷",
    "民间借贷纠纷",
]

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to the sorting task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g. 《判决文书 1》)")
    cause_of_action: Literal[tuple(ALLOWED_CAUSES)] = Field(description="The cause of action category this document belongs to, as defined in the task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="A list of all parsed documents and their assigned causes")
